_taxonomy.field_notes: `status` is the lifecycle label (where this file sits in the project). `quality` is reserved for a separate axis (e.g. correctness/confidence) and may be filled in later. See docs/status_taxonomy.md for definitions.

genesis_multiscale_audit.py.description: Isolated classical multiscale organization audit with matched planar summaries and independent perturbation-response cohorts. Preserves V1 and V2.
genesis_multiscale_audit.py.quality: validated audit; first predictive gate not passed
genesis_multiscale_audit.py.notes: Writes a frozen protocol, raw snapshots and targets, held-out predictions and metrics. Refuses existing output directories. Does not establish a bulk or holographic correspondence. See the vault implementation note.

genesis_measure.py.description: Headless measurement harness — runs the active genesis_grid pipeline and logs observables to JSON/CSV. Single-run, multi-seed, kappa-sweep, and geometry-compare modes.
genesis_measure.py.notes: Multi-seed mode produced a confirmed negative SSB result on 2026-04-12. The system orders but consistently picks the square-lattice diagonal, indicating explicit symmetry breaking by topology rather than spontaneous breaking. Full writeup: findings/2026-04-12_ssb_lattice_bias.md

genesis_object_census.py.description: Headless census of tracked vortex-antivortex candidates with time-stamped object attributes.
genesis_object_census.py.notes: Read-only observer of the active genesis_grid pipeline. Persistent candidate status is a declared threshold, not evidence of autonomy, natural kinds, or metaphysical claims. See docs/Genesis Scheme Vault/40-Experiments/Higher-Order Object Detection Spec.md.

genesis_object_sensitivity.py.description: Headless detector-sensitivity sweep for v1 vortex-antivortex pair candidates.
genesis_object_sensitivity.py.notes: Holds v1 dynamics and seeds fixed while varying only sampling interval and pairing radius. It measures distributional robustness, not one-to-one object identity or autonomy.

genesis_v2_intervention.py.description: Paired potentiality-actuality intervention test for the experimental Genesis v2 engine.
genesis_v2_intervention.py.notes: Tests bidirectional P/A consequences in the v2 coupled-field scaffold. A nonzero divergence demonstrates distinct implemented state roles, not metaphysical validation.

genesis_v2_measure.py.description: Headless multi-seed baseline measurement for the experimental Genesis v2 P/A/R engine.
genesis_v2_measure.py.notes: Measures unperturbed actual order, potential strength, P/A alignment, and relation strength before v2 visual or object-level claims.

genesis_v2_beta_measure.py.description: Headless baseline measurement for the rule-based Genesis v2-beta engine.
genesis_v2_beta_measure.py.notes: Tests distinction persistence after v2-alpha collapsed potentiality into actuality.

genesis_v2_beta_intervention.py.description: Multi-seed paired intervention test for the rule-based Genesis v2-beta engine.
genesis_v2_beta_intervention.py.notes: Rechecks bidirectional P/A consequences after introducing the beta rule layer.

genesis_v2_beta_sweep.py.description: Headless parameter-regime map for the rule-based Genesis v2-beta engine.
genesis_v2_beta_sweep.py.notes: Maps distinction, spatial coherence, and late-time stability without prematurely labeling patterns as objects.

genesis_v2_beta_inspect.py.description: Four-panel visual inspector for the distinction-preserving Genesis v2-beta regime.
genesis_v2_beta_inspect.py.notes: Shows actuality, latent potential direction, availability, and P/A difference. It is for hypothesis generation, not object proof.

genesis_v2_gamma_measure.py.description: Headless baseline measurement for the boundary-forming Genesis v2-gamma hypothesis.
genesis_v2_gamma_measure.py.notes: Measures whether a separate boundary/permeability field remains active while P/A distinction persists. It makes no object-level claim.

genesis_v2_gamma_domains.py.description: Headless cutoff-sensitivity and identity-tracking census of v2-gamma relation-bounded regions.
genesis_v2_gamma_domains.py.notes: Sweeps the declared relation-permeability cutoff and tracks component identity across samples. Persistent components remain candidates, not established objects.

genesis_v2_gamma_perturb.py.description: Paired localized-perturbation probe for v2-gamma relation-bounded components.
genesis_v2_gamma_perturb.py.notes: Compares the continuity and disturbance propagation of an observer-defined component against an unperturbed control. It does not establish autonomy or causal closure.

genesis_v2_gamma_location_control.py.description: Paired inside-versus-outside perturbation control for v2-gamma relation-bounded components.
genesis_v2_gamma_location_control.py.notes: Uses equal perturbations inside and outside a candidate domain to test whether its response differs from surrounding field behavior. The first five-seed run found a bounded, location-specific response; scale robustness remains untested.

genesis_v2_gamma_finite_size.py.description: Finite-size and observer-cutoff robustness sweep for v2-gamma bounded-response candidates.
genesis_v2_gamma_finite_size.py.notes: Tests whether the location-control result survives modest lattice-size and cutoff changes. It is a finite-size test, not a continuum-resolution claim.

genesis_v2_gamma_forecast.py.description: Forecast test comparing v2-gamma candidate identity persistence against equal-shape background masks.
genesis_v2_gamma_forecast.py.notes: Tests whether candidate attributes forecast future identity better than a translated background mask. It does not establish autonomy or natural kinds.

genesis_v2_gamma_attribute_model.py.description: Grouped held-out test of whether v2-gamma region attributes improve persistence forecasts beyond size, cutoff, and area.
genesis_v2_gamma_attribute_model.py.notes: Holds out whole seeds and compares an area/condition baseline with a fuller region-attribute ridge model. It is a prediction test, not an autonomy claim.

genesis_v2_gamma_boundary_causality.py.description: Causal boundary intervention comparing selected v2-gamma candidates with equal-size background regions.
genesis_v2_gamma_boundary_causality.py.notes: Directly weakens or strengthens stored perimeter boundaries to test their causal contribution to candidate identity and recovery. It does not establish autonomy.

genesis_v2_gamma_recovery.py.description: Long-horizon recovery test after weakening a v2-gamma candidate boundary.
genesis_v2_gamma_recovery.py.notes: Compares candidate-boundary recovery with untouched and exact-shape background weakening controls. It tests model-level restoration, not autonomy.

genesis_v2_gamma_dynamic_recovery.py.description: Motion-aware continuity tracker for v2-gamma candidates after matched boundary weakening.
genesis_v2_gamma_dynamic_recovery.py.notes: Uses consecutive-sample overlap to distinguish motion or transformation from track loss after causal boundary intervention.

genesis_v2_delta_sweep.py.description: Initial scale-selection regime sweep for the v2-delta short-range coherence and long-range counter-relation hypothesis.
genesis_v2_delta_sweep.py.notes: Tests whether a specified competing-scale rule avoids gamma coarsening without P/A collapse or noise fragmentation. It is not an object claim.

genesis_v2_delta_stationarity.py.description: Long-horizon finite-scale stationarity probe for the v2-delta competing-scale hypothesis.
genesis_v2_delta_stationarity.py.notes: Samples delta relation-domain size distributions over time to distinguish a bounded characteristic scale from delayed coarsening or fragmentation. It is not an object claim.

genesis_v2_epsilon_sweep.py.description: Initial regime sweep for the v2-epsilon slow resource-renewal hypothesis.
genesis_v2_epsilon_sweep.py.notes: Tests whether coherent actuality consuming slowly renewed, spatially transported potential availability prevents runaway merger. It is not an object claim.

genesis_v2_epsilon_stationarity.py.description: Long-horizon finite-scale stationarity probe for the v2-epsilon resource-renewal hypothesis.
genesis_v2_epsilon_stationarity.py.notes: Samples epsilon relation-domain distributions through time to distinguish sustained bounded scale from delayed coarsening or fragmentation. It is not an object claim.

genesis_v2_zeta_sweep.py.description: Initial regime sweep for the v2-zeta coherence-driven refractory benchmark.
genesis_v2_zeta_sweep.py.notes: Tests delayed local inhibition that directly suppresses further alignment without a global clock. This is a benchmark against known activator-refractory dynamics, not a novelty claim.

genesis_v2_zeta_stationarity.py.description: Long-horizon finite-scale and refractory-state probe for the v2-zeta benchmark.
genesis_v2_zeta_stationarity.py.notes: Tests whether zeta maintains finite relation-domain scale and nontrivial refractory dynamics after its initial regime map. It is not an object or novelty claim.

genesis_v2_integrated_probe.py.description: Headless first comparison for the V1-derived potentiality/actuality structural bridge.
genesis_v2_integrated_probe.py.notes: Checks V1 parity against one independently defined P-to-A intervention before relation-memory or object claims. See findings/2026-10-11_v2_integrated_first_bridge.md.

genesis_v2_integrated_relation_probe.py.description: Tracked-candidate comparison for edge relation memory in the V1-derived P/A/R bridge.
genesis_v2_integrated_relation_probe.py.notes: Adds only remembered edge incompatibility as a contribution to inherited structural tension. It records candidate persistence, not objects.

genesis_v2_integrated_relation_sweep.py.description: Predeclared relation-memory strength sweep for the V1-derived P/A/R bridge.
genesis_v2_integrated_relation_sweep.py.notes: Reports P/A distinction, compression, global order, and tracked candidate persistence across fixed relation-memory strengths. No strength improved persistence in the first sweep.

genesis_v1_compression_ablation.py.description: Causal population-level ablation of V1 geometry/compression with tracked pair candidates.
genesis_v1_compression_ablation.py.notes: Varying geometry coupling changed compression but did not materially change pair persistence in the first five-seed test. This does not establish compression as a stabilizer.

genesis_v1_local_structure_perturbation..description: Matched local candidate-neighborhood versus background structural perturbation test for V1 pairs.
genesis_v1_local_structure_perturbation..notes: The first ten-seed result showed a provisional local continuation signal requiring a fixed 30-seed replication. Strict constituent-ID continuation does not count transformations as survival.

genesis_v2_integrated_local_structure_pr.description: Thirty-seed comparison of V1-parity and independent P-to-A dynamics using the matched local structural continuation test.
genesis_v2_integrated_local_structure_pr.notes: P-to-A dynamics preserved the validated local structural effect but did not yet demonstrate a new capability beyond V1.

genesis_v2_integrated_potential_perturba.description: Matched candidate-neighborhood versus background potential-direction rotation test in the V1-derived P/A bridge.
genesis_v2_integrated_potential_perturba.notes: The first 30-seed 90-degree local rotation did not resolve a strict continuation effect; it does not establish P as irrelevant.

genesis_v2_integrated_high_compression_a.description: Paired field-level audit of the P-to-A coupling against V1 parity in the high-compression regime.
genesis_v2_integrated_high_compression_a.notes: P-to-A changed alignment, tension, and vortex count across 20 fixed seeds, without resolving a global-order or mean-compression difference.

genesis_v2_integrated_potential_propagat.description: Matched candidate versus background test for far-field effects of a local P-direction rotation.
genesis_v2_integrated_potential_propagat.notes: The 30-seed test found no candidate-specific far-field response in A, tension, or compression at the tested coupling and horizon.

genesis_v2_integrated_coupling_dose_resp.description: Fixed-seed field and strict-continuation dose response for P-to-A coupling strength.
genesis_v2_integrated_coupling_dose_resp.notes: Across 20 seeds, coupling strength gave a coherent field dose response while the V1 local structural effect remained significant at every tested gain.

genesis_v1_pair_object_gate.py.description: Held-out forecast gate comparing V1 pair relational state against an equal-information generic local-field baseline.
genesis_v1_pair_object_gate.py.notes: Two independent ten-seed cohorts gave relational-model wins in 19 of 20 held-out seeds but missed the predeclared 5% pooled Brier-reduction gate.

genesis_v1_vortex_census.py.description: Headless census of individual integer-winding V1 vortex candidates.
genesis_v1_vortex_census.py.notes: The individual vortex is the supported V1 topological-object target, unlike the heuristic pair relation.

genesis_v1_vortex_robustness.py.description: Matched smooth-core versus background perturbation test for individual V1 vortex identity.
genesis_v1_vortex_robustness.py.notes: A smooth core twist did not reduce strict ID-and-charge continuation across 20 fixed seeds.

genesis_grid_emergence.py.notes: Uses genesis_grid engine directly instead of inline physics. The compression locking mechanism freezes theta in folded regions, creating bistable structure. Sliders: Align, Tension, Geometry, Phase, Lock strength.
